headline: Nigeria Requires $30 Billion Investment in Petroleum Infrastructure by 2030
summary: The Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority stated that Nigeria needs about $30 billion in investments by 2030 to expand petroleum infrastructure.
why: Infrastructure expansion is critical for Nigeria to improve domestic energy security and optimize petroleum processing capabilities.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Attracting billions in capital expenditure is required to upgrade midstream and downstream oil facilities.
